title: 第一卷 第28章 他在车里等她
content_zh:
童喻见到了方印。

    以前的高中同学很少联系，高考后上了大学，基本都是各奔东西。

    大学毕业了，除非特意约见，根本就不可能碰上。

    方印穿着西装打着领带，整个人很精神。

    “童美女。”方印笑着走过来，“几年不见，你越来越漂亮了。”

    童喻笑，“你帅得我都差点认不出来了。”

    方印笑得眼睛都眯了起来。

    “怎么了？我这个么大个人，你当看不见？”冯姿故作不高兴的质问方印。

    方印看向冯姿，“怎么可能？我有你的微信，早就习惯了你的美貌。”

    冯姿笑得露出一口白牙，“这还差不多。”

    “你们想喝什么，我们边喝边聊。”方印坐下来，手机扫了一下桌子上的二维码，递给童喻。

    童喻赶紧摇头，“这怎么行？是我有事找你，理应我来请。”

    “这么多年第一次碰面，让我展示一下男士的风度。”方印笑着说：“先让我请一次，这样你们肯定还要再请我一次。”

    “阴险。”冯姿嘴上这么说着，接过他的手机，“那就给你一个展示风度的机会吧。”

    方印坐下，“多谢给这个机会。”

    点了喝的，方印还点了小吃。

    童喻开门见山，把自己目前遇到的问题告诉了他。

    方印收了笑脸，“我听冯姿提过一嘴。这事，我也只能回头跟我舅舅说一下。但是，不敢保证能达到你要的效果。”

    “我知道。你能帮我出这个面，就已经很感谢了。医院有医院的规章制度，什么都得按规矩来的。总之，谢谢你。”童喻也不想让别人做为难的事。

    毕竟，看似只是一句话的事，别人肯定是要付出更多才能得到的。

    “你不用这么早就说谢谢。”

    “方印，大家同窗三年，你要是能帮，可一定要帮一把。”冯姿也很诚恳，“我们感激不尽。”

    方印点头，“你们放心吧。大家同学一场，能帮肯定要帮的。”

    见过方印，童喻心里总算是踏实了几分。

    不管结果如何，她至少是努力过了。

    。

    小区的电已经恢复了。

    童喻正常上着班，白天只要有课也会去上，如果方印那里能有好消息，肯定是要很大一笔钱的。她得好好上班，多多赚钱。

    那天之后，霍放没有联系过童喻，也没有到【云上】。

    童喻自然也不会去问。

    霍放做什么，她都没有资格过问。
content_en:
Tong Yu saw Fang Yin.

    I had very little contact with my former high school classmates. After the college entrance examination and entering university, they basically went their separate ways.

    After graduating from college, it is impossible to meet someone unless you make a special appointment.

    Fang Yin was wearing a suit and tie, looking very energetic.

    "Young beauty." Fang Yin walked over with a smile, "I haven't seen you for a few years, and you are getting more and more beautiful."

    Tong Yu smiled, "You are so handsome that I almost didn't recognize you."

    Fang Yin smiled so hard that his eyes narrowed.

    "What's wrong? I'm such a big man, do you think you can't see me?" Feng Zi asked Fang Yin, pretending to be unhappy.

    Fang Yin looked at Feng Zi, "How is that possible? I have your WeChat account and I have long been accustomed to your beauty."

    Feng Zi smiled, revealing her white teeth, "That's pretty much it."

    "What do you want to drink? Let's chat while drinking." Fang Yin sat down, scanned the QR code on the table with his phone, and handed it to Tong Yu.

    Tong Yu quickly shook his head, "How can this be done? I have something to ask you for, so I should be the one to do it."

    "This is the first time we have met in so many years. Let me show off my manly demeanor." Fang Yin said with a smile: "Let me invite you once, so you will definitely want to invite me again."

    "Insidious." Feng Zi said this and took his mobile phone. "Then let me give you a chance to show your grace."

    Fang Yin sat down and said, "Thank you for this opportunity."

    After ordering drinks, Fang Yin also ordered snacks.

    Tong Yu got straight to the point and told him the problems he was currently encountering.

    Fang Yin stopped smiling, "I heard Feng Zi mention it. I can only talk to my uncle about this later. However, I can't guarantee that it will achieve the effect you want."

    "I know. I'm very grateful that you can help me with this. The hospital has hospital rules and regulations, and everything must be done according to the rules. In short, thank you." Tong Yu didn't want others to do anything difficult.

    After all, for something that seems to be just a sentence, others must have to pay more to get it.

    "You don't have to say thank you so early."

    "Fang Yin, we have been classmates for three years. If you can help, you must help." Feng Zi was also very sincere, "We can't thank you enough."

    Fang Yin nodded, "Don't worry. We are all classmates. If you can help, you will definitely help."

    After meeting Fang Yin, Tong Yu finally felt a little more at ease.

    Regardless of the outcome, she at least tried hard.

    .

    The power to the community has been restored.

    Tong Yu goes to work normally and goes to school whenever there are classes during the day. If there is good news from Fang Yin, it will definitely cost a lot of money. She has to work hard and make more money.

    After that day, Huo Fang did not contact Tong Yu, nor did he come to [Yunshang].

    Naturally, Tong Yu wouldn't ask.

    She was not qualified to ask what Huo Fang did.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 28 He was waiting for her in the car
